people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.
translations.bsb: At the same time, he was hoping that Paul would offer him a bribe. So he sent for Paul frequently and talked with him.
translations.kjv: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
translations.asv: He hoped withal that money would be given him of Paul: wherefore also he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
